units.rawText: I'm back... you went out helping agents again? Didn't I tell you to sit still and wait for me?
units.displayText: I'm back... you went out helping agents again? Didn't I tell you to sit still and wait for me?

spans.text: I'm back... you went out helping agents again? Didn't I tell you to sit still and wait for me?

units.rawText: I can't just sit here and do nothing. I'm not going to sit there and watch them be gunned down by those Sanctifiers.
units.displayText: I can't just sit here and do nothing. I'm not going to sit there and watch them be gunned down by those Sanctifiers.

spans.text: I can't just sit here and do nothing. I'm not going to sit there and watch them be gunned down by those Sanctifiers.

units.rawText: ...Torso surface dissolved, inner coating heavily damaged. Limb replacement won't do the job. She needs surgery immediately.

units.rawText: What about Linny?
units.displayText: What about Linny?

units.rawText: When you've found a safe spot, I'll head over myself.
units.displayText: When you've found a safe spot, I'll head over myself.

units.rawText: But Suu...
units.displayText: But Suu...

spans.text: But Suu...

units.rawText: I can travel underground. It'll be safer for me to move alone. These agents also need you, no?
units.displayText: I can travel underground. It'll be safer for me to move alone. These agents also need you, no?

spans.text: I can travel underground. It'll be safer for me to move alone. These agents also need you, no?

units.rawText: We won't accomplish anything by trying to have the best of both worlds, and as it is we can't get over there together anyway.
